Looking at the quick metrics from our ingestion logs: there was a policy push at 02:15 UTC that changed the per-tenant quota enforcement. It appears the new policy inadvertently translated a per-customer burst allowance into a global pool cap for the a12-prod cluster. In short, the token-bucket burst parameter was set to 0.5x due to a unit mismatch in the rollout script.

I pulled a short log snippet (attached) showing the quota re-evaluation loop. At the same time we saw a small surge from a partner integration which, when combined with the reduced burst window, produced queueing and downstream 5xxs.

Immediate suggestions:
1) Roll back the policy change for the a12-prod cluster (safe, low-risk).
2) Apply a temporary per-tenant override to increase burst to previous baseline (10x) while we run a targeted test.
3) Add a short-term fallback routing rule: route requests tagged "nightly-ingest" to the dedicated-a12-alt pool (smaller model, lower cost) to relieve pressure.

I'm attaching logs-snippet.txt and the exact config diff. If we get a sign-off I can roll back now.

- Karthik
